integrity: Symbolic proof over all prime characteristics; standalone exact finite-power checks are supplementary, not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Cartier-iterate image ranks and stable p-rank only; no assertion of the full Ekedahl--Oort type, complete Newton polygon, polarization or independence of related work. Equivalence in unsurveyed specialized literature remains possible.
title: Complete Cartier-iterate ranks for prime-power Hurwitz curves
